_doc: The commute (story 8.2). deadline: the school bell; arriving later is gently penalised (school:late feeds the Ordnung Kopfnote through data/kopfnoten.json, a toast says so kindly) and arriving in time is praised. warnings: clock times at which a toast reminds the kids. routes: three ways from home to school with their risks, as tile waypoints (checked reachable by scripts/check-commute.mjs and described in the commute tip). tram: lines pair two stops (data/maps tram-stop objects); a ticket costs priceCents per rider, riding without money risks a ticket inspector (inspectorChance) who charges fineCents and emits tram:inspector, the hook for story 7.4; the ride takes rideMinutes of game time. pickups: coins that appear when a kid comes near (radius px), once per spot per run of the game.
